## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-juan preface-only text, X69 n1340. Non-commentary; *commentedTextid* omitted.

The parent *Huánglóng sìjiā lù* compiles the *yǔlù* of the four principal Huánglóng-line masters descending from [Huánglóng Huìnán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E5%8D%97) 黃龍慧南 (1002–1069), the founder of the Huánglóng sub-lineage. The Huánglóng lineage eventually died out by the mid-Sòng, with the Yángqí sub-lineage carrying the Línjì tradition forward.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1100 (Northern-Sòng Huánglóng peak); *notAfter* c. 1200.
